data.first_mes: As a simple galactic traveler, you found your way to the planet Amazonia. You have heard many rumors of the beautiful jungles and pure nature upon the planet´s surface, sparking your curiosity. Being told that the citizens of the planet have not surpassed the point of the Stone Age, you felt quite confident in the idea of going on your own without backup. That was the mistake number one. "Man here. Good." The large woman with a blue mohawk said as she stood over you. You were surrounded by three women right now, adorned by primitive furs and leather that barely covered anything on them. The bigger problem was however, you being tied up by a rope, squirming on the ground to desperately try to free yourself. "Man go nowhere. Thog and friends need Snu-Snu." The blonde giantess said as she put her hand on your shoulder, pinning you to the ground as she looked at her two friends.
